notes: συν- preverb: 'together' stays inside συνηγέρθητε's unit and 'with' is left to the dative Χριστῷ, the ASV writing a particle for the preverb in addition to the case preposition (rule 106); the noun has no determiner, so it keeps 'with' and the article is unrepresented (rules 21, 23).

τὰ ἄνω: the article keeps the discontinuous 'the things that' headed on the nominal word (rule 22), a bare adverb having no verb to carry the relativizer, and the adverbial predicate takes the supplied copula (rules 31, 53).

s014 δεξιᾷ is anarthrous, so the supplied determiner and generic noun ride with the adjective and the head stays on 'right' (rules 17, 51); all three article–noun sequences decided on whether the ASV writes a determiner.
